rating.comments: Ignoring the pasted task statement, the student supplied the inputs ("5000 students", "5 days per week", "2 liters" per day) and reached "50000 liters per week" and "10000 liters" per day, which implies a multi-step chain, but no steps are written out. Earlier figures are applied to the problem, and the student adds their own saving idea ("that woud save 5000 liters every week") without justifying it. The student asks no questions and says "i dont know" once. Several task-focused attempts appear across the conversation, but there is little checking or follow-through.
